text.tspan: LayerNormLSTMCell / three independent norms | Operators & tensor flow
One step / I=H=16 / custom LayerNorm branch explicitly selected / read bottom to top
I=H=16; norm_i/norm_h widths64; norm_c width16; three independent gamma/beta pairs.
Explicit custom branch: population std and no epsilon; source code was not run.
Return contract: hy and nested state(hy,cy), with normalized cy.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.

g.aria-label: 节点 lnlstm.x Input x

节点 lnlstm.c State cell cx
节点 lnlstm.output Return hy, (hy,cy)
节点 lnlstm.wi Input matrix product / no bias
节点 lnlstm.wh Hidden matrix product / no bias
节点 lnlstm.lni.mean Mean over last axis
节点 lnlstm.lni.std Std / unbiased=False
节点 lnlstm.lni.center Input - mean
节点 lnlstm.lni.divide Divide by std / no epsilon
节点 lnlstm.lni.affine Learned gamma + beta
节点 lnlstm.lnh.mean Mean over last axis
节点 lnlstm.lnh.std Std / unbiased=False
节点 lnlstm.lnh.center Input - mean
节点 lnlstm.lnh.divide Divide by std / no epsilon

节点 lnlstm.gates Add separately normalized affines
节点 lnlstm.split Chunk4 / input,forget,cell,output

节点 lnlstm.f Sigmoid forget f
节点 lnlstm.g Tanh cell candidate g
节点 lnlstm.o Sigmoid output o
节点 lnlstm.keep f * previous cell
节点 lnlstm.new i * candidate g
节点 lnlstm.cadd Sum retained + new cell
节点 lnlstm.lnc.mean Mean over last axis
节点 lnlstm.lnc.std Std / unbiased=False
